definitions.explanation: A sliding motion on a touchscreen with a finger to navigate or interact with content.

examples.japanese: {右|みぎ}にスワイプすると{次|つぎ}の{写真|しゃしん}が{見|み}られる。
examples.english: Swipe right to see the next photo.

examples.japanese: {画面|がめん}を{上|うえ}にスワイプしてください。
examples.english: Please swipe up on the screen.

examples.japanese: {気|き}に{入|い}ったら{右|みぎ}スワイプ、{興味|きょうみ}がなければ{左|ひだり}スワイプ。
examples.english: Swipe right if you like it, swipe left if not interested.

notes:
LOANWORD:
From English 'swipe.'

TECH CONTEXT:
Used exclusively for touchscreen interactions on smartphones, tablets, etc.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{右|みぎ}/{左|ひだり}/{上|うえ}/{下|した}にスワイプする (swipe right/left/up/down)
・スワイプ{操作|そうさ} (swipe operation)

RELATED TERMS:
・タップ (tap - single touch)
・スクロール (scroll - continuous sliding)
・ピンチ (pinch - zoom gesture)

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
{右|みぎ}スワイプ and {左|ひだり}スワイプ became culturally significant with dating apps like Tinder, where swiping right indicates interest.
